faq.a: Because no two businesses have the same site and processes. The plan sets the scope; the discovery call sets the exact monthly price, which then stays fixed.

faq.q: Which plan should we start with?
faq.a: If you mainly need a reliable website and a first process in order, start with Essentials. If you want more leads and less admin, Growth is the usual starting point. The free audit ends with a recommendation.

faq.q: Do you bill by the hour?
faq.a: No. You pay a monthly price for an agreed scope. We plan priorities with you every month and report on results, not timesheets.

faq.q: What if we need more in one month?
faq.a: Larger pieces of work — a new site, a CRM rollout, an internal app — run as a fixed-price project next to your plan. If it keeps happening, moving up a plan is usually the better deal.
After the minimum three months, the plan ends at the end of the month you cancel. You keep everything: code, content, tools, accounts and documentation.

faq.q: Do you sign an NDA and a data processing agreement?
faq.a: Yes. We sign your NDA on request, and a data processing agreement (DPA) is part of every plan.
